_info: Stock (standard) configuration of ONE engine, loaded automatically when this engine is selected and by the button 'Load stock configuration'. File name = engine id. 'chargers': a catalog id (string) or {"profile": {...}, "count": n} for a part that belongs to this engine only. Maps use the shared rpm axis [800,2000,3500,5000,6000,7000] and load axis [0,25,50,75,100] ([loadIdx][rpmIdx]). 'reference' holds a known factory power figure for later calibration.
name: Toyota 3K - stock configuration
generated: ignition and fuel maps derived from the shared base maps: rpm axis stretched to this engine's redline, fuel scaled by displacement per cylinder, ignition for a naturally aspirated engine (low-load row, 0.1 deg retard per % load)

reference.standard: PS as published by encycarpedia for the 1975 spec; the 60 hp headline uses the hp value as published
reference.variant: 3K 8-valve OHV 1.2 L (1,166 cc), 60 hp version of the 1969-1977 range
reference.source: rollaclub.com forum post quoting the Wikipedia 'Toyota K engine' list: 3K 60 hp at 6000 rpm; encycarpedia.com 1975 Toyota Corolla 1.2 (3K, 9:1, 75 x 66 mm): 55 PS / 54 BHP at 6000 rpm, 85 N·m at 3800 rpm
reference.notes: Headline 60 hp is a second-hand quote from a single source. Encycarpedia lists 55 PS at 6000 rpm and 85 N·m at 3800 rpm for the same 9:1 and 75 x 66 mm engine, so the power figure conflicts with the 60 hp headline by about 6 hp. The headline value is kept unchanged; the discrepancy should be resolved during calibration. Bore/stroke and redline 6000 rpm are consistent. The Wikipedia list also gives 84 hp (3K-BR) and 97 hp (3K-B) for other variants.
